info.title: Vehicle Availability Service
info.description:
This service keeps track of the vehicles currently available in a given city area.

It periodically checks an external mobility provider, transforms that data into the
service's own internal model and updates the current availability state.

Its main goal is to detect when new vehicles appear and when previously available
vehicles are no longer present, keeping the latest known state ready to be queried
through the API.

In short, this microservice answers a simple question:
which vehicles are available right now according to the latest polling cycle?

tags.name: Vehicles
tags.description: Get which vehicles are currently available in the monitored area

get.description: Returns the latest list of vehicles available according to the most recent polling cycle
